Welcome

So glad you're here

Welcome to our home. We are so excited you chose to stay with us at Executive Beach Apartment and we hope you love your stay and Newcastle as much as we do.

Executive Beach Apartment sits on level 8 of Arena with an enclosed balcony offering panoramic ocean and beach views — perfect for whale and dolphin watching. A queen bedroom, sofa bed, ocean views and one secure parking space.

We prefer to keep in touch via the booking platform you used, and we are quick to reply. Don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything at all.

Good to Know

Everything you need

🌡

Air Conditioning

Ducted reverse cycle. Control panel on kitchen wall. Day/night switch — day flows to whole apartment, night to bedroom only. Green light top right = unit on.

📶

WiFi

Network: MyRepublic C613-5GHz
Password: tj8bzn68ze

🧬

Laundry

Separate washing machine and dryer. Detergent provided.

📺

Television

Smart TV. Use your own Netflix, Stan etc. accounts.

🌐

Balcony

Enclosed balcony with panoramic ocean and beach views. A perfect spot for morning coffee and whale watching.

👁

Exhaust Fan

The bathroom fan sometimes runs after the bathroom light is switched on. To turn it off, switch off the powerpoint labelled 'exhaust fan' in the laundry cupboard.

👁

Bins

Garbage room on level B2.

🌌

Sofa Bed

The sofa pulls out to a double bed. Linen is in the left side of the bedroom wardrobe. Please strip it before checkout.

Arriving

Check-in from 3:00 PM

⏰

Your Check-in Details

Keys are collected from 67 Watt Street (the building to the left of Arena). Letterbox 211 is next to the glass doors. Full details including your lockbox code will be sent 48 hours before arrival via your booking platform.

🏠

Finding the Apartment

Make your way to 75 Shortland Esplanade. Enter through the glass doors to Foyer A. Swipe the fob and take the lift to Level 8. Apartment A803 will be signposted from the lift.

Before You Leave

Check-out by 11:00 AM

You will receive a reminder message the evening before your check-out via your booking platform.

🧹

Tidy Up

Leave wet towels in the bathroom, stack and run the dishwasher, and take all rubbish to the bin room on level B2.

💡

Turn Off

Turn off all lights, appliances and air conditioning before you leave.

🔑

Return Keys

Lock all doors and windows, then return your keys to the lockbox. Full details in your check-out reminder.

Getting Around

Transport & Parking

🚗

Parking

One secure underground parking space included (space A803, level P10). Enter via the driveway at 75 Shortland Esplanade. Press button 2 on the remote, drive to level P10, space is on the left. Free all-day parking is available 200m away on the Watt Street hill past the police station. Free street parking out front after 5pm weekdays, 1pm Saturdays, all day Sundays.

🚋

Light Rail

Newcastle Beach light rail stop is just a few minutes walk. Services run every 7 minutes connecting to the Wickham Interchange and buses and trains throughout Newcastle. McDonald Jones Stadium is just 20 minutes by public transport.

🚅

Rideshare & Taxi

Uber, Ola and Shebah all operate in Newcastle. Easy pickup from Shortland Esplanade.

⛵

Stockton Ferry

Catch the ferry from Queens Wharf to Stockton for a brilliant half-day out. Explore the foreshore, shipwreck remains and the sweeping Stockton sand dunes.

Get Outside

Beaches, Baths & Walks

Beach · 2 min walk

Newcastle Beach

One of Australia's best surf beaches. Lifeguards patrol daily. Surf club, change rooms and kiosk on site.

Ocean Pool · 3 min walk

Newcastle Ocean Baths

Iconic Art Deco ocean pool. Recently revitalised with free entry, lifeguards and warm showers.

Beach · 10 min walk

Nobbys Beach

Newcastle's most famous beach. Great for families and watching dolphins from the shore.

Ocean Pool · 15 min walk

Bogey Hole

A must-see carved rock pool in King Edward Park. Spectacular at high tide.

Walk · At your door

ANZAC Memorial Walk

Stunning 450m tribute starting right at your doorstep. Links to the 6km Bathers Way coastal track.

Walk · 10 min walk

Newcastle Harbour Walk

From Nobbys along the foreshore through Queens Wharf to Honeysuckle. Wheelchair friendly.

Walk · 15 min walk

Nobbys Breakwall

Walk to the iconic Nobbys Lighthouse. Watch coal ships guided into the harbour by tugboats.

Day Walk · 15 min drive

Yuelarbah Track

Great day walk in Glenrock with lookout, waterfalls and picnic spots.

Reserve · 20 min drive

Blackbutt Reserve

182 hectares of wildlife, playgrounds and nature trails. Koala feeding at 2pm daily. Free entry.

House Rules

A few things to keep in mind

🚫

No Smoking

Completely smoke-free inside and outside at all times, including vaping.

🔊

Noise & Neighbours

Please respect our permanent neighbours. Keep the volume low after 10pm.

🧊

No Parties

No parties, schoolies, hens or bucks celebrations. A responsible adult must be present at all times.

🐶

No Pets

We are unable to accommodate pets of any kind.

🚪

Strata Building

Guests are subject to the building strata by-laws during their stay. Please be mindful of residents in surrounding apartments and common areas.

👥

Rubbish

Please take all rubbish to the bin room in sealed bags before check-out. Bin room is on level B2.

Breaking house rules will result in the booking being cancelled without refund. By staying at Executive Beach Apartment, guests agree to comply with the NSW STRA Code of Conduct and the Arena strata by-laws. Registration: PID-STRA-7056-2.
